title: Amazon dropped a finished Altman movie amid a $50B OpenAI deal
title_zh: 亚马逊在价值 500 亿美元的 OpenAI 交易中放弃了一部已完成的奥特曼电影
summary: Every company likes to believe it can sit through a hard story about itself. The real test arrives when the hard story is about someone the company just handed an enormous check. For about three years, Hollywood and Silicon Valley have circled each other with mutual suspicion.
summary_zh: 每家公司都愿意相信自己能够安然度过有关自己的艰难故事。当公司刚刚向某个人发放巨额支票时，真正的考验就到来了。大约三年来，好莱坞和硅谷一直互相猜疑。

title: Qualcomm CFO talks Modular acquisition's significance for AI data centers
title_zh: 高通首席财务官谈论模块化收购对人工智能数据中心的意义
summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) CFO and COO Akash Palkhiwala joins Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley to discuss the AI chipmaker's announced acquisition of AI software infrastructure startup Modular.
summary_zh: 高通 (QCOM) 首席财务官兼首席运营官 Akash Palkhiwala 与雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 一起讨论这家 AI 芯片制造商宣布收购 AI 软件基础设施初创公司 Modular。

title: ARES vs. KKR: Which Asset Manager Offers Better Upside Now?
title_zh: ARES 与 KKR：哪个资产管理公司现在提供更好的优势？
summary: Ares Management and KKR & Co are benefiting from growing AUM, strategic acquisitions and expanding investment capabilities. Which stock is the better pick now?
summary_zh: Ares Management 和 KKR & Co 正受益于不断增长的资产管理规模、战略收购和不断扩大的投资能力。现在选择哪只股票更好？

title: Carlyle finalises $2.8bn acquisition of majority stake in MAI Capital
title_zh: 凯雷完成 28 亿美元收购 MAI Capital 多数股权
summary: The existing management of MAI remains in place, with the business maintaining operational independence.
summary_zh: MAI 现有管理层保持不变，业务保持运营独立性。

title: Carlyle Moves On $700 Million Korea Succession Deal
title_zh: 凯雷推进 7 亿美元韩国继任协议
summary: Carlyle agreed to buy Chung Ho Group as inheritance-tax pressures reshape Korea's private business M&A market.
summary_zh: 由于遗产税压力重塑了韩国私营企业并购市场，凯雷同意收购中和集团。
